model.name: Professional License / Credential
model.purpose: Describe an individually awarded professional credential with evidenced scope, issuer, validity and governance.
model.scope_statement: One governed award record with references to its subject, scheme, issuing authority, status evidence and recognition decisions; not an automatic grant of professional practice rights.
in_scope: Award identity, credential kind, subject binding, issuer and scheme references
Award basis, scope, continuing requirements, status and remedies
Verification observations, privacy-aware presentation and loss-aware mapping
out_of_scope: Issuing or revoking a real credential, professional advice or legal eligibility decisions
Mastering person identity, complete training records or regulator case files
Implementing cryptographic verification, external register access or jurisdictional rule engines

boundary_notes.distinction: Scheme requirements and individual award have separate identities and maintenance cycles.
Award subject and repository holder may differ; identity masters remain references.
Qualification and valid document do not alone authorize the intended role or location.
Proof validity and claim truth are distinct; envelope ID is not necessarily award ID.
Registry parent is a general conceptual alignment, not verified structural inheritance.

composition.purpose: Candidate general attestation alignment, not ratified inheritance.
Optional envelope projection with separate award identity.
Optional purpose-aware status evidence; adapter pending.
Selected healthcare qualification mapping, not practice authority.
Scheme and requirements references; not a substitute for individual award.

owner_package_requirements: Declare award-record owner and authorized steward.
Identify subject, scheme, issuer and status evidence masters.
Bind disclosure, freshness, correction, retention and reliance policies.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Use issuer-qualified award IDs; keep subject, scheme, envelope and local revision IDs distinct. Do not expose private identity in public paths.
registry_links: Status observation and protected evidence registry

canonicalization_rules: Preserve source vocabulary, award scope and authority qualifiers.
Separate effective intervals, envelope periods and observation times; unknown is not active.
patch_rules: Pin base version and digest; namespace profession and jurisdiction profiles.
Append corrections under expected-head checks; retain competing reports where permitted.
compatibility_rules: Do not merge license, certification, membership and qualification semantics.
Refuse export when required scope, status freshness or authority qualifiers would be lost.

artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Use RFC 3339 seconds and explicit offset or Z for recording instants; preserve date-only and uncertain effective periods separately.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Opaque award ID, record kind and revision; no personal names or disciplinary details in filenames.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Check exact-byte digest and revision; integrity never proves issuer authority or permission to practise.

policies: No real issuance, revocation, regulator contact or personal-record lookup follows from filling this model.
Never equate good signature, active local record, qualification and current practice permission.
Treat unavailable or stale status as unknown under the relying policy, not good standing.
Collect only necessary authorized evidence and protect disciplinary or assessment details.

read: Read Dimension policy, pinned specification, assurance holds and permitted evidence scope before accessing award records.
create: Record an authorized attributed award assertion; keep unknown issuer/subject binding explicit.
update: Append status observations or corrections with evidence, effective time and expected-head guard; local edit cannot reverse issuer decisions.
delete: Apply retention, legal holds and justified deletion to local records; preserve only permitted minimal tombstones. Local deletion does not revoke an award.

roles.name: Dimension owner
responsibilities: Delegates local memory authority, not credential-issuing rights.

roles.name: Credential steward
responsibilities: Maintains attributed award and scope records.

roles.name: Reviewer
responsibilities: Checks binding, freshness and loss limits without inventing legal authority.

access.default_rule: Deny absent purpose-specific authority; public-register visibility is not unlimited redistribution permission.
exceptions: Explicit scoped time-limited exception with authorizer and rationale, never an implicit privilege from credential possession.
audit_requirements: Log operation, opaque award/revision and authorized outcome; do not log secrets or restricted evidence contents.

read_order: Award identity, scope and source-qualified status
Validation, disclosure, patching and retirement rules

coverage.claim: Bounded professional award memory draft, not global licensing law, cryptographic runtime or independent review.

checklist.notes: Award, subject, scheme and envelope distinct.
Credential kind and profession vocabulary qualified.
Scope, issuer, level and validity are explicit.
Evidenced identification and jurisdictional recognition are separate.
Six bounded record operations, not practice privileges.
Issuance record, renewal, status change, remedy and retirement.
Subject, issuer, scheme and relying party referenced.
Effective intervals and observation time distinct.
Authority and evidence preserved per assertion.
Record stewardship does not confer regulator powers.
Local deletion does not revoke the credential.
Research structure validated; executable nested fields, legal rules and negative runtime fixtures are not implemented.
Credential is an informational award record; physical document properties belong to its carrier.

known_omissions: Both external providers timed out once; no independent external review.
Selected clauses only; exact dated pins, updates, source licenses and full mappings pending.
GMC UK, EU recognition and FHIR healthcare examples are not universal professional rules.
Direct CTDL License term fetch unavailable; only selected handbook content admitted.
No executable nested schemas, status-list adapter, cryptographic verification, jurisdiction engine or ratified composition.
regional_assumptions: Jurisdiction and profession profiles require competent source verification before operational reliance.
adversarial_checks: A holder may not be the subject.
Valid proof does not establish truth or issuer authority.
Registration is not necessarily a license.
Qualification does not authorize every organization or location.
Stale or missing status is not good standing.
Recognition similarity does not confer permission.
Local deletion or correction cannot revoke or restore a real award.
